wiki.title: Marie Alvarado-Gil
wiki.extract: Marie Issa Alvarado-Gil (born December 24, 1973) is an American educator and politician who represents California's 4th State Senate district in the California State Senate, following her election in 2022. Elected as a member of the Democratic Party, she joined the Republican Party in August 2024.
